memory_candidates.content: The literature extension's index/search layer (literature-build-index.sh chunk discovery + source_path reads; literature-search.sh's do_read()) is already format-agnostic. The only format-hardcoded spot in the whole pipeline is literature-ingest.sh's output-discovery glob `ls "$TMP_MD_DIR"/*.md`. Useful context before proposing any future markup-format change to the literature pipeline.

`source_format` in the literature index (specs/literature/index.json and the global index.json) is a document-level provenance field with values pdf/djvu/manual describing the original source document type. It is NOT a column on literature-schema.sql's chunks_data/FTS5 table and carries no information about chunk markup dialect (markdown vs. any alternative). Any future proposal conflating the two should be corrected against this distinction.
